concerns.text: SC-001 defines the tipping point only as 'where geometric ambiguity resolution fails' without anchoring the constitution-mandated and idea-stated operational bound: the tipping point where local-only attention fails to maintain >80% mIoU in dense scenes (Constitution Principle VI; idea Expected results). The spec should state the mIoU reference threshold so the tipping point is identifiable, not just 'a knee in the curve'.
